title: Uguduga kw'Umurosi
intro: Umutima wari waragenewe kuba uwukomeye, yamara ugeragejwe n’ibigeragezo bikomeye, waratanguye urugendo rudasanzwe. Inzira y’uwo muntu yari irangwa n’ishari, ugutandukana n’imibabaro idakwiriye, gushika aho ashika ku rwego rwo hejuru rw’inshingano nyinshi cane no gusubirana cane. Woba ushobora kumenya uwo mubare udasanzwe muri Korowani?
clues: Narigeze gushirwa ishari n’abo twari hafi cane, ivyo bikaba vyatumye ntandukana cane n’umuvyeyi wanje be n’i muhira.
Naciye mu kiringo c’ingorane nyinshi, harimwo no kugurishwa ku giciro gitoyi n’abagenzi.
Naragirijwe ata co nkora ikibi maze mara imyaka n’iyindi mw’ibohero, yamara ukwizera kwanje kwagumye kudahungabana.
Narahawe ubushobozi budasanzwe bwo gusobanura iyerekwa rigoye, ivyo bikaba vyaramfashije cane mu nzira yanje yo kwidegemvya.
Ubwenge bwanje n’ubunyankamugayo bwanje vyatumye amaherezo ngira ikibanza c’ubukuru n’ukwizigira cane mu gihugu c’amahanga.
Biciye ku bintu vyinshi vyabaye, narasubiye kubonana n’umuvyeyi wanje ageze mu zabukuru be n’abavukanyi banje inyuma y’igihe kirekire ntaboneka kandi bibabaje.

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Kuronka urubanza rw’Imana ku bantu b’abibone .
Gutwara ubwami buhambaye mu bukerebutsi no mu butungane .

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِأَبِيهِ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى رَأَيْتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَبًۭا وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ رَأَيْتُهُمْ لِى سَـٰجِدِينَ
verse: [Of these stories mention] when Joseph said to his father, "O my father, indeed I have seen [in a dream] eleven stars and the sun and the moon; I saw them prostrating to me." (12:4)
